steps: In GitHub Desktop, fetch and pull feature/gold-v19-wave-shadow.
Keep the existing CSV paths and Shadow activation state unchanged.
Run scripts/gold_wave_shadow_v19/06_CONFIGURE_DISCORD.bat and enter the webhook URL locally.
Run scripts/gold_wave_shadow_v19/07_TEST_DISCORD.bat and confirm the Japanese test message and M15 chart.
Use 04_STATUS.bat for Shadow state and 09_DISCORD_STATUS.bat for delivery state.
stop_conditions: Any runtime parity or source-data contract error
Unexpected CSV schema or overlap conflict
Model update cannot be built causally
Unexpected session gap invalidates an open observation
discord_delivery_errors: Discord errors do not stop or alter the Shadow runtime
Do not replay alerts missed while the notifier was stopped
Do not run two notifier loops at once
Never commit or paste the webhook URL
not_stop_conditions: P85 or P95 looking better after activation
A temporary Discord outage when the Shadow runtime remains healthy
